camel_example: aliyun cas CreateDeploymentJob --region cn-hangzhou --JobType user --CertIds '12342649,12304338,12067351,9957285' --ResourceIds '6591316,6585549,6190248,5811894,5775176,5772504' --Name jobName --ContactIds '1,2'
description_en: Creates a certificate deployment task to deploy an SSL certificate to one or more Alibaba Cloud services immediately or at a scheduled time
description_zh: SSL证书签发完成后，您可以通过该接口创建不同类型的证书部署任务，立即或手动指定任务部署时间，将SSL证书部署到阿里云产品或三方云产品，为您的业务网站提供可信身份认证和安全数据传输
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-deployment-job --name jobName --job-type user --cert-ids 12342649,12304338,12067351,9957285 --resource-ids 6591316,6585549,6190248,5811894,5775176,5772504 --contact-ids 1,2 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeploymentJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the deployment task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the deployment task.

Valid values:

cloud: multi-cloud deployment task.

user: cloud service deployment task. This type of task does not support cloud servers
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate. Separate multiple certificate IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html operation to obtain the IDs of certificates from the CertificateId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 证书ID，多个证书ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html返回的**CertificateId**
parameters.name: cert_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud resource. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html operation to obtain the IDs of cloud resources from the Id parameter
parameters.help_zh: 云产品资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html返回的主键**Id**
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact. Separate multiple contact IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html operation to obtain the IDs of contacts from the ContactId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 联系人ID。多个联系人ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html返回的主键**Id**
parameters.name: contact_ids

parameters.help_en: The time when the task starts. The value is a UNIX timestamp. If you do not specify this parameter, the system immediately starts the task after the task is in the pending state
parameters.help_zh: 设置任务开始调度的时间（Unix时间戳）。如果不设置，在任务处于待执行状态时将立即执行部署
parameters.name: schedule_time

JobId.description_en: The ID of the deployment task

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
